title: 196 Sanctuary Lakes South Boulevard, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogTitle: 196 Sanctuary Lakes South Boulevard, Point Cook, Vic 3030
ogDescription:
Perfectly positioned in the prestigious Sanctuary Lakes precinct, this beautifully presented family home delivers the ideal combination of space, comfort and serene waterfront living. Set on a generous allotment of approximately 558m², the residence is filled with natural light and offers versatile living zones designed for modern family life.

With a thoughtfully designed layout, quality finishes and tranquil water views, this home creates a warm and welcoming environment where families can relax, entertain and enjoy the lifestyle that Point Cook is renowned for. Properties in this sought-after location rarely become available, making this a fantastic opportunity for families and investors alike.

Property Features
• Four spacious bedrooms, including a master suite with private ensuite
• Central family bathroom servicing the remaining bedrooms
• Multiple living zones with two generous living areas, ideal for family flexibility and entertaining
• Modern kitchen fitted with stainless steel appliances and ample storage
• Open living and dining areas designed to capture abundant natural light
• Remote-controlled double garage with secure internal access
• Central ducted heating ensuring comfort throughout the colder months
• Split system air conditioning for year-round climate control
• Stylish combination of timber flooring and comfortable carpeted areas
• Positioned on a waterfront allotment offering tranquil outlooks
• Generous approximately 558m² land size providing space for outdoor enjoyment
• Well-designed family layout ideal for growing families
• Located within the prestigious Sanctuary Lakes community, close to parks, walking trails, shopping and schools

Offering space, natural light and a peaceful waterfront setting, this home represents an exceptional opportunity to secure a quality residence in one of Point Cook’s most desirable neighbourhoods. Whether you are looking for a comfortable family home or a smart addition to your portfolio, this property delivers lifestyle, location and long-term appeal.

Contact us today to arrange your inspection and experience the lifestyle this home has to offer.

*Please note open for inspection times and property availability is subject to change or cancellation without notice.

title: 41 Baycrest Drive, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
*Register Your Inspection Appointment*

H&T Homes proudly presents this exceptional family residence in the prestigious Saltwater Coast Estate, one of Point Cook’s most sought-after communities.

Perfectly positioned opposite a beautiful park and set on a generous 448m² (approx.) allotment, this well-designed family home offers an outstanding combination of space, comfort, convenience, and lifestyle. Whether you are a growing family, first-home buyer, or savvy investor, this property presents an opportunity not to be missed.

Location features:

• Convenient, central location with local amenities like St. Mary of the Cross Catholic Primary School, Creative Early Learning Centre, surrounded parks, playgrounds and sporting ovals, and public transport to train stations. Excellent location within walking distance of wetlands and Crocodile Park with views of the city, BBQs.

• Easily accessible to local shopping with Saltwater Tribeca Village Shopping Complex, Sanctuary Lakes Shopping Centre, Featherbrook Shopping Centre and Point Cook Town Centre.

• Short walks to the Saltwater Lifestyle Centre featuring a wide range of the latest sporting and recreational facilities for residents and their guests. You’ll find a fully equipped gym, under cover, outdoor and kids’ pool, tennis courts, function room, café and BBQ facilities just a few steps from your front door.

House features:

- Set on a 448m² (approx.) allotment, this architecturally designed home showcases a thoughtfully planned layout tailored for modern family living.

- he residence features a spacious open-plan design complemented by multiple living zones, including a formal dining area, a family living area and an additional leisure space, offering flexibility for both everyday living and entertaining.

- The modern kitchen is the heart of the home, complete with stone benchtops, a full-sized pantry, and quality stainless-steel appliances, including a 900mm gas cooktop, rangehood, and dishwasher — perfect for family meals and hosting guests.

- Accommodation comprises four well-sized bedrooms, with the master suite featuring a walk-in robe and private ensuite. The remaining bedrooms are serviced by a central bathroom, making the home ideal for families of all sizes.

- Additional features include heating and cooling for year-round comfort, an alarm system for added security, and stylish downlights throughout. A double remote-control garage with internal access enhances convenience, while the low-maintenance front and backyard provide easy upkeep and more time to enjoy the lifestyle this home offers.

This is a fantastic opportunity to secure a quality home in one of Point Cook’s most desirable and fast-growing communities.

Extras Include:
- LED Downlights
- Gas Ducted Heating
- Evaporated Cooling
- Quality Roller Blinds
- All Windows and Sliding Door Come with Insect Screens
- Concrete Walkways Around Building Perimeter to Protect Building Foundation
And so much more……

It is time to call now to arrange a private inspection and secure this property! Arrange an inspection by contacting：

Mia
0414537102
mia@htrealty.com.au

Photo ID Required at all Inspections.




Note: Information contained on any marketing material, website and all other portals should not be relied upon. You should make your own enquiries and seek your own independent advice in relation to any property advertised.



Please see the below link for an up-to-date copy of the Due Diligence Check List:
www.consumer.vic.gov.au/duediligencechecklist

title: 39 Edge View, Point Cook, Vic 3030 - House for Sale - realestate.com.au
ogDescription:
Welcome to 39 Edge View, Point Cook – a beautifully presented family home offering an impressive combination of space, comfort and everyday convenience in a highly sought-after location.

Ideal for growing families, first home buyers or savvy investors, this inviting residence has been thoughtfully designed to provide flexible living spaces and a relaxed, low-maintenance lifestyle.

Step inside and you’ll discover a light-filled and well-designed floorplan featuring multiple living zones, giving everyone in the family their own space to enjoy. A separate formal lounge provides the perfect setting to unwind, while the additional living area offers plenty of room for everyday family life and entertaining. With the flexibility to create a dedicated home office, study or private retreat, the layout is perfectly suited to today’s modern lifestyle.

The home features four generous bedrooms, including a spacious main bedroom complete with its own private ensuite and built-in robe. The remaining bedrooms are also fitted with robes and are conveniently serviced by a centrally located family bathroom complete with a bathtub.

At the heart of the home is the contemporary kitchen, positioned to connect effortlessly with the main living areas and creating a welcoming space for family meals, entertaining guests or simply enjoying time together.

Perfectly positioned in the heart of Point Cook, the home enjoys easy access to local schools, shopping centres, parks, public transport and a wide range of community amenities. With everyday essentials all within easy reach, the location offers the convenience and lifestyle that makes Point Cook such a popular choice for families.

For investors, the property offers the added advantage of an existing tenancy, with the home currently leased until February 2027. The current renter has also indicated they would be happy to continue their tenancy should the property be purchased by an investor, providing an appealing opportunity for those looking to add an established rental property to their portfolio.

Offering generous accommodation, multiple living spaces and a convenient Point Cook location, 39 Edge View presents an excellent opportunity to secure a home with the space and flexibility to enjoy now and into the future.
